name: Zoltán Kovács
bio:
Zoltán's journey into motorsport began unconventionally, not through racing dreams, but through a fascination with organizational efficiency. While studying business administration at Corvinus University of Budapest, he volunteered at local karting events, quickly realizing the pivotal role of human resources in a team's success. He streamlined volunteer recruitment and scheduling, significantly improving event logistics.

After graduating, Zoltán honed his HR skills at a tech startup, focusing on talent acquisition and employee development. He brings a data-driven approach to HR, believing in optimizing team performance through strategic hiring and fostering a positive work environment. His passion is identifying and nurturing talent, ensuring every team member contributes their best.

Zoltán's distinctive strength lies in his analytical mindset combined with a genuine empathy for people. He excels at understanding individual needs and aligning them with organizational goals, making him a valuable asset to any motorsport team seeking a competitive edge.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed to the side with a slight fade
physical.description: Zoltán is of average height with a lean build and a focused expression.

quirks: Always has a meticulously organized spreadsheet for tracking candidate progress.
Prefers conducting initial interviews in a quiet, distraction-free environment.
Keeps a small collection of vintage motorsport posters in his office.
